explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/92: 'Or even f(n) < n^{O(1/log log n)}?' — also disproved, since it is stronger than f(n) ≤ n^{o(1)}, which the page records as disproved via [90]. The Lean statement is the negation ¬ ∃ c > 0, ∀ᶠ n, f n ≤ n^{c/log log n}. The non-strict inequality versus the page's strict one is immaterial for a statement with an unspecified constant. Faithful.
